{{Quote|What kind of love could be more pure than that of a pet lover for their pet.|[[Schill|Dr. Schill]]|<ref name="SWG:TCOA">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>}}
'''Carson Vance''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] and pet lover who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|You found Peaches!! Thank you, thank you, thank you!!!|Carson Vance|<ref name="SWG:TCOA" />}}
Vance owned a pet [[durni]] called [[Peaches]]. During the [[Festival of Love]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Vance was present in the town of [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], when he lost Peaches. A [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] offered to look for Peaches and soon found the creature, then returned it to Vance.

==Behind the scenes==
Carson Vae appeared as a non-player character in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
